topic: Real space-biology run: NASA GeneLab GLDS-1 (Drosophila spaceflight transcriptome) read by Hs.
purpose: Local node for the space-biology real-data run -- the OSDR arm of the Earth/space program.
paths_note: key_files relative to THIS folder; join_the_chain relative to the Hs repo root.

specific_knowledge.what: GLDS-1/OSD-1 = GeneLab's first study (Drosophila immune response in spaceflight, Affymetrix). Hs read the uninfected ground->flight subset over all 18,952 probesets as a per-sample composition.
key_results: Tier 1: LOSSLESS high-D read at D=18,952 (reconstruction 1.2e-13) -- a real ~19k-dimensional transcriptome, deterministic (hash bcdc19e9)
Tier 1: HONEST GLOBAL NULL -- whole-transcriptome ground-vs-flight Aitchison distance = 0.95x within-group replicate variation (no global separation)
Tier 2: the null -> seek-a-signature lesson (same as the Crohn microbiome null + MC-4); GeneLab DE table is the gene-level complement
specific_knowledge.claim_tiers: Tier 1 = lossless D=18,952 + the global-null distances; Tier 2 = the null->signature lesson; Tier 3 = any biological conclusion + microarray-as-composition validity (use GeneLab DE / RNA-seq counts).

bring_your_own_ai: Start at README.md. Data source: NASA OSDR s3://nasa-osdr/ (OSD-1). Derived composition off-repo; raw not redistributed. Read-only context; governance + claim-tiers apply.
governance: HUF-STD-001; instrument not data; honest-broker (the null is reported straight); defer biology to GeneLab's differential-expression analysis; no AI commits.
